title: Voice AI Platforms Compared: Leaping AI vs Craft
summary: Comparing Leaping AI and Craftflow (Craft) for home remodelers: speed to lead, CRM integrations, multilingual calling and more.
body_markdown:
By[Kevin Wu](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kevin-wu-452a6393/) , CEO at Leaping AI


Leaping AI and Craftflow (Craft) are two AI providers in the home remodeling space. This article is geared towards home remodeling CEOs / Director of Marketing executives that are looking to compare the two solutions for[voice AI calling and AI texting](https://leapingai.com/blog/how-home-improvement-businesses-use-voice-ai-and-ai-texting-to-automate-growth) .


## **Commonalities**


Both solutions handle[inbound](https://leapingai.com/products/inbound-voice-ai) and[outbound calling](https://leapingai.com/products/outbound-voice-ai) and[texting](https://leapingai.com/products/sms-agents) for appointment setting use cases. They integrate into a variety of CRMs, such as[MarketSharp](https://leapingai.com/blog/marketsharp-leaping-ai-the-only-voice-and-texting-ai-that-integrates-with-marketsharp) ,[LeadPerfection](https://leapingai.com/blog/leadperfection-voice-ai-integration) ,[i360](https://leapingai.com/blog/improveit360-voice-ai-integration) ,[BuilderPrime](https://leapingai.com/blog/builder-prime-voice-ai-integration) ,[Acculynx](https://leapingai.com/blog/best-voice-ai-for-acculynx-roofing-software) , and[Hubspot](https://leapingai.com/blog/voice-ai-agents-for-hubspot) . Both solutions offer analytics and reporting to make sense of call results.


## **Difference 1: Leaping AI has sub-10-second speed to lead**


On their website, Craft promises a sub-30 second-speed to lead reach-out time for web leads. Leaping AI is able to top that with a[sub-10-second speed to lead](https://leapingai.com/blog/maximize-speed-to-lead-with-voice-ai-for-roofing) reach-out time. In home remodeling, every second counts as leads often go to various companies and whoever can reach out faster usually has the first conversation with the homeowner to schedule an appointment.


## **Difference 2: Leaping AI does not rely on REST APIs only**


Craft integrates into CRM systems via REST APIs. The problem is that many CRMs in the space, such as MarketSharp and Acculynx lack well-defined APIs. Leaping AI has a proprietary web AI agent technology that logs into a CRM like a human would in order to read from a calendar and write back to it. We are thus the only company in the space able to integrate into some more custom or[harder to crack CRM systems](https://leapingai.com/blog/bridging-old-and-new-integrating-voice-ai-with-legacy-tech) .


## **Difference 3: Leaping AI focuses on home remodeling and roofing**


Craft seems to have a wider focus, including targeting HVAC companies. Leaping AI focuses on[home remodeling](https://leapingai.com/industries/voice-ai-for-home-improvement) ([window](https://leapingai.com/industries/voice-ai-for-window-and-door-companies) ,[bathroom](https://leapingai.com/industries/voice-ai-for-bathroom-remodeling) ,[kitchen](https://leapingai.com/industries/voice-ai-for-kitchen-remodeling) ,[pavers](https://leapingai.com/industries/voice-ai-for-outdoor-living-companies) ,[siding](https://leapingai.com/industries/voice-ai-for-siding-companies) , gutter, pool enclosure) and[roofing companies](https://leapingai.com/industries/voice-ai-for-roofing-companies) , and builds tailor-made solutions for this industry.


## **Difference 4: Leaping AI can handle over 100 different languages**


Leaping AI has a library of voices in[over 100 different languages](https://leapingai.com/blog/multilingual-voice-ai) . The AI agent is able to easily speak English +[Spanish](https://leapingai.com/blog/capturing-the-spanish-speaking-market-with-advanced-voice-ai-technology) + Canadian French at the same time. Many home remodeling companies have multi-state operations and require a solution that can handle homeowners from different parts of North America (e.g. Florida, Quebec).


## **Difference 5: Leaping AI voice AI agents go beyond appointment scheduling**


We handle a variety of call center calls that go beyond appointment scheduling. For instance, Leaping AI voice and texting agents can handle[appointment confirmation](https://leapingai.com/blog/how-to-automate-appointment-reminders-with-sms-and-voice-ai) and service calls, thus helping to alleviate the load on the[human call center team](https://leapingai.com/blog/beyond-human-vs-ai-how-voice-ai-and-human-agents-create-the-perfect-customer-service-hybrid) .


## **Difference 6: DNC scrubbing and number rotation**


Leaping AI has internal software to maintain a DNC database and make sure that numbers are continuously marked as healthy. Unhealthy numbers can be removed on a weekly basis and subbed out by healthy numbers.


In conclusion, while both Craft and Leaping offer voice AI and texting AI features, Leaping AI seems to be the more capable solution for home remodeling CEOs and Director of Marketing executives that want to increase speed to lead,[improve appointment set rates](https://leapingai.com/blog/improve-appointment-set-rate-for-window-companies) and[increase their business revenues](https://leapingai.com/blog/home-remodeling-revenue-with-voice-ai) .
